clos.loDetails: Students can capture and respond to a wide variety of customer needs in the field of MICE event; understand the MICE procedure. Link this subject knowledge with other subjects of hospitality management. In addition, due to the nature of MICE  is not the same, so this subject emphasizes the creativity and sensitivity of students in the organization.
Students acquire important skills: organizational skills, organizational planning and programming skills, contract drafting skills, script writing skills, management skills and supervisory skill.

Students can analyze and identify the requirements of the MICE event to show the ability to serve and meet the needs of customers professionally in order to gain customer satisfaction. Can handle situations in a flexible way.
Students are trained to perform professional ethics; have the spirit and professional service attitude; Forming the love of work and the spirit of serving the society as professional service staff.
